1.title: Azure DNS and Load Balancing
1.text: Welcome to Module fourteen: Azure D N S and Load Balancing. It covers the exam area Implement and manage virtual networking. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do four things. Configure Azure D N S. Configure an internal or public load balancer. Troubleshoot load balancing. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Exam area: Implement and manage virtual networking (fifteen-twenty percent). Exam format: one hundred minutes; a score of seven hundred on a scale of one to one thousand passes. Validated against: the official Microsoft Learn A Z-one hundred four study guide, skills measured as of October twenty-six, two thousand twenty-three.

1.title: Azure DNS
1.text: Azure D N S. Azure D N S hosts D N S zones and answers queries from Microsoft's global name servers. Public D N S zone. Resolves names on the internet (for example contoso dot com ); delegate the domain by setting the registrar's name servers (N S) to the four Azure name servers. Private D N S zone. Resolves names inside virtual networks (for example internal dot contoso dot com ); link the zone to V nets; auto-registration adds V M records automatically.

1.title: Azure DNS, continued
1.text: Azure D N S. A or A A A A. Name to IPv four or IPv six address. C N A M E. Name to another name (alias); not allowed at the zone apex. M X. Mail servers. T X T. Text, verification, S P F. N S or S O A. Zone delegation and authority. Alias record. Points a record at an Azure resource (public I P, load balancer, Traffic Manager, Front Door); works at the apex and updates automatically.

1.title: Azure DNS, continued
1.text: Azure D N S. The figure shows this: A public zone delegated from a registrar, and a private zone linked to a virtual network. Exam tip: "The apex domain must point to an Azure public I P or load balancer and follow I P changes" equals an alias record. V Ms resolve each other by name inside a V net equals private D N S zone (with auto-registration).

1.title: Azure Load Balancer
1.text: Azure Load Balancer. Azure Load Balancer is a layer four (T C P and U D P) load balancer that spreads inbound flows across healthy instances. Public load balancer. Internet-facing frontend (public I P). Internal load balancer. Private frontend I P inside a V net.

1.title: Azure Load Balancer, continued
1.text: Azure Load Balancer. Frontend I P. Where clients connect. Backend pool. The V Ms or scale set instances receiving traffic. Health probe. Checks instance health (T C P, H T T P, H T T P S); unhealthy instances get no traffic. Load-balancing rule. Maps frontend I P and port to backend pool and port. Inbound nat rule. Forwards one frontend port to one V M (for example R D P to a specific V M). Outbound rules. Control outbound S N A T for backend instances. Distribution uses a five-tuple hash (source I P and port, destination I P and port, protocol); session persistence (source I P) keeps a client on the same instance. S K Us: Standard (zone-redundant, secure by default, needs an N S G to allow traffic, S L A (service level agreement)) and Basic (being retired ).

1.title: Azure Load Balancer, continued
1.text: Azure Load Balancer. The figure shows this: A load balancer with frontend I P, rule, health probe and backend pool.

1.title: Troubleshooting load balancing
1.text: Troubleshooting load balancing. No traffic reaches backends. Health probe failing; N S G blocking the Azure Load Balancer service tag or the client traffic. One V M gets no traffic. Probe fails on that V M, or the app is not listening on the probe port. Cannot reach the frontend. N S G blocks the port; Standard L B needs an N S G allow rule. Outbound failures. S N A T exhaustion: use outbound rules or a nat gateway. Exam tip: Layer four (T C P or U D P) equals Azure Load Balancer. H T T P routing, U R L paths and waff equals Application Gateway (layer seven). D N S-based global routing equals Traffic Manager. Exam tip: Layer four equals Azure Load Balancer; layer seven equals Application Gateway. Match the layer to the requirement.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. A company wants contoso.com (the zone apex) to point to a load balancer's public I P and follow I P changes. What should be created? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: An alias record. Alias records work at the apex and track the Azure resource.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. V Ms in a virtual network must resolve each other by name, with records created automatically. What should be used? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: A private D N S zone linked to the V net with auto-registration. Private zones with auto-registration add V M records.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. A load balancer's backend V Ms receive no traffic. The health probe fails. Which N S G issue is common? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: The N S G blocks the Azure Load Balancer service tag. Probes come from the Azure Load Balancer tag and must be allowed.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. Which load balancer type has a private frontend I P address? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Internal. Internal load balancers use a private frontend I P.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. Which rule forwards one frontend port to a single V M for R D P? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Inbound nat rule. Inbound nat rules map a frontend port to one backend V M.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. What O S I layer does Azure Load Balancer work at? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Layer four. It balances T C P and U D P flows at layer four.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. What record type points a name to another name? Answer: C N A M E. Question two. What must you change at your registrar to delegate a domain to Azure D N S? Answer: The name servers (N S records). Question three. What does a health probe do? Answer: Checks backend health so unhealthy instances get no traffic.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. What does Standard Load Balancer require for inbound traffic? Answer: An N S G rule that allows it. Question five. What does a private D N S zone link do? Answer: Lets V nets resolve names in the zone. Question six. Which service is the layer seven option? Answer: Application Gateway.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Azure D N S: public zones (delegate N S), private zones (linked, auto-registration), alias records at the apex. Load Balancer: layer four; public or internal; frontend, pool, probe, rules, nat rules. Troubleshoot: probes, N S G on Azure Load Balancer, S N A T exhaustion. Others: Application Gateway (layer seven), Traffic Manager (D N S-based).
